newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Woolwich set to pull out of Dubai.
- Emirates airlines aircraft maintenance centre to be operational in September.
- Qatar to host global geographic information system conference in March.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan offers to send mediator to Sudan.
- UAE ministry of agriculture signs contract with consultancy firm to study construction of dams.
- China trade with GCC at $3.88 billion in 1996.
